## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The pull request adds helpers to refresh fingerprints and register new files. The refresh helper can erase evidence of edits to tracked files and should be corrected before merge.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — When `tracked.txt` has been edited after its fingerprint was recorded, refreshing `["tracked.txt", "new.txt"]` overwrites its original fingerprint with the edited file’s digest. — Subsequent verification accepts the edited tracked file, defeating the stated integrity guarantee.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- The registration helper preserves existing fingerprints, with a test confirming that verification still detects an edited tracked file.
- Tests cover empty input and duplicate registration names.
